key_insight: The paper introduces UPOM and DU-UPOM to solve inequality-constrained combinatorial optimization without slack variables, reducing qubit and tuning overhead while keeping the method trainable.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for implementing smaller, easier-to-embed QUBO formulations on quantum annealers, especially for constrained problems like knapsack.
method: Combines unbalanced penalization with the Ohzeki method for inequality constraints.
Replaces two fixed penalty coefficients with an auxiliary-variable update.
Deep-unfolds the update rule so the step-size schedule is learned from training instances.
evidence_signal: On random knapsack instances, the abstract reports that UPOM outperforms original UP and DU-UPOM reaches optimal solutions in fewer iterations than fixed-step UPOM and other baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on learned step-size schedules and auxiliary updates, so generalization and robustness to new problem distributions may require careful validation.
paper_title: Slack-Free Deep-Unfolded Combinatorial Optimization Solver for Inequality Constraints
